rationale: The claim is for an interruption of the trip because a child was left at home, which is not one of the five covered reasons in section 2 of the policy wording (version 2026.1). Section 2 states "We do not pay for cancellation or interruption for any other reason," so the one-way fare home and the unused hotel nights are not payable, even though the incident was inside the covered trip and was filed within 90 days. Decided under claims manual section 2 (decline where the wording does not cover the claim) and section 4 steps 4 to 5.
